candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe hard. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. I count e breath for one minute. E chest no dey go inside as e dey breathe. Pikin calm as I check am. E dey cough for 3 days. Pulse oximeter dey available but I no fit get the reading. E no dey wheeze all the time. E dey breathe 35 times for one minute. E no get stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze now. Pikin no dey convulse now. Dem never see convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything.
